lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地走过冰面。
lines.en: I waddle across the ice.
I sway with each step, belly heavy.
I test the ground with my feet.
I slide a little and catch myself.
I follow the one ahead in line.
I shuffle to the water's edge.
My flippers hang at my sides.

lines.zh: 我走过一片雪，留下印子。
lines.en: I cross the snow and leave prints.
I pause at each step, careful.
I skirt a crack in the ice.

lines.zh: 我在冰面上滑了一段，撞上雪堆。
lines.en: I slide across the ice and hit a snow pile.

lines.zh: 我在水里比在岸上灵活。
lines.en: I'm better in water than on land.
I surface and shake myself.
I walk a crooked line.
I slide along the ice.
My shadow trails on the ice.
I waddle up a small slope.
I stop and call out.
I stand on the ice and look far.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮贴在冰上滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slide a short way on my belly across the ice.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在冰面上回荡。
lines.en: My cry echoes over the ice.
The cold wind suits me.
I settle and hide my feet.
I watch the light on the water.
My belly touches the ice.
A few of us stand together.
I flap my flippers. I don't fly.
I wait for the dark to deepen.
I turn toward the wind.

lines.zh: 冰面上没有一点别的响声。
lines.en: Nothing else sounds on the ice.
I pull my head into my shoulders.
I wait for the right time to dive.
I tap the ice with my beak.

lines.zh: 我的脚很凉，可我不介意。
lines.en: My feet are cold. I don't mind.
You walk the ice carefully.

lines.zh: 你用脚尖试探冰面，我懂。
lines.en: You test the ice with your toe; I understand.
Do you smell of fish?
I call at you.
I waddle two steps closer.
You're giving off steam.
I spread my flippers to look bigger.
There's water behind you.
I stand at your feet.
You laugh, and I call back.

lines.zh: 这点冷对我来说不算什么。
lines.en: This cold is nothing to me.
There's only me here.
I flop down onto the ice.

lines.zh: 我摇着走，冰上倒是不滑。
lines.en: I waddle, yet the ice does not trip me.
I wobble worse now.

lines.zh: 我跌坐在冰上，滑出去一段。
lines.en: I flop onto the ice and slide.

lines.zh: 我在冰上滑了一小段，又站住。
lines.en: I slide a little way on the ice and stop.
That sent me sliding.
I flap my flippers to steady.

lines.zh: 我疼，可我叫不出声，冰面太滑。
lines.en: It hurts, but I cannot cry out; the ice is slick.
You hit the root of my flipper.
I need to get into the water.
That smells like fish, doesn't it?
You raise the fish.
I waddle over.
That smell. I like it.
I stretch my head and peck.
Lower your hand a little more.
I won't peck it from your hand.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在你手里摆尾。
lines.en: The fish in your hand still flicks its tail.
I press against your foot.
Stay and I'll come closer.
That smell makes me want to call.
I lower my head to your palm.
I'm not leaving. I want more.

lines.zh: 我靠在你靴边取暖，不动了。
lines.en: I huddle by your boot for warmth and go still.
That's enough to please me.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴地滑，能滑很远。
lines.en: On my belly I slide a long way.
You bump me and I slide away.
I lean aside.
My flipper slaps you.
Don't push; I can't hold on the ice.
We collide and both wobble.
You step on my flipper.
I wobble twice before I steady.
That sat me down on the ice.
I lean on you for warmth.
I waddle two steps off.
Another waddles up.
Our beaks touch.
Its chest is whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 企鹅一叫，冰面上都是回声。
lines.en: One penguin call echoes over the ice.
It rests its head on my shoulder.
We call together, loudly.
We dive into the water together.
Two of us waddle on the ice.
It preens my neck.

lines.zh: 这一群，以后有我们两个。
lines.en: This group will have both of us.
I peck up a small fish.

lines.zh: 我把它甩了两下，吞下去。
lines.en: I flip it twice and swallow.
Too slippery; I drop it.
I nudge it with my beak.
It fell in the water; I dive.
This fish is mine.
I carry it onto the ice.
I'll stash this and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 这条鱼冻硬了，我叼着甩两下。
lines.en: The fish is frozen stiff; I shake it twice in my beak.
One toss of my head and it's out.
You're on my flipper.
I spread my flippers and brace.
My call carries over the whole ice.
This ice is mine.

lines.zh: 我的鳍张开，脚掌抓稳冰。
lines.en: My flippers spread and my feet grip the ice.
I lower my beak to my chest.
This beak cracks ice just fine.
I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，朝你的靴子冲。
lines.en: I lower my body and charge your boots.
I'll call more of my kind.
I waddle after you.

lines.zh: 我摇摆着跟在你鞋印上。
lines.en: I waddle along your boot prints.
I'm on the other side of the crack.
My calls haven't stopped.
I waddle closer.
The ice is slick; you'll slow.
I'm two steps behind you.
I've walked this ice more than you.
I call twice more at the sky.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰面滑，肚皮很凉。
lines.en: I slide along the ice, my belly cold.
I peck the back of your hand.
That peck had little behind it.
My call carries across the beach.
You pull back; I waddle after.
I bump your shin.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己弹开了。
lines.en: That bounced me off.
I bump your ankle from the side.
That nearly put you on the ice.

lines.zh: 我的鳍拍在你裤脚上，很湿。
lines.en: My flipper slaps your trouser leg, wet and cold.
I spread my flippers to look big.

lines.zh: 冰面上多了一个黑白的影子。
lines.en: A black-and-white shape joins the ice.
I come up out of the water.
I shake the drops from my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从冰窟窿里爬上来，抖水。
lines.en: I climb out of the ice hole and shake off the water.
I waddle to a stop.
I call and look around.
I stamp the ice to test it.
I'll stay on this ice.
I come around a snowdrift.
I tuck my feet under my belly.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的羽毛就缩了。
lines.en: Fire shrivels my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从冰台上摔下去，摊在冰上。
lines.en: I fall off the ledge and sprawl on the ice.
The water is too deep; I can't surface.
The blast throws me onto the ice.
Something grazes my flipper.
The spell pins my flippers.
There are no fish in this water.
Lightning flashes and I forget to call.
The ice is gone and I fall.
